name: Auto Sprint+
statusMeaning: Tried in the game with Kiln.
author: febreze.gamerz
description: A Minecraft mod that adds auto sprint, no need to press or hold ctrl any more.
works: Sprints for you while you walk forward, and always draws a box at the top left (gui 10,10, 190x26) saying 'Sprint: Toggled'; the box hides with the GUI (F1), as its code checks Hud.isHidden.
note: From Modrinth, unchanged. Not yet: its settings screen and HUD editor (key Y) don't open; its toggle key has no default; the check uses F1 hiding its always-on box, so it assumes F1 hides the GUI in Horizon; the mod works without it
